lesson.title: Telford Hall Episode 2
lesson.title_ar: القسم الأدبي (5): قصة تيلفورد هول — الحلقة 2: عطلة الشتاء، عيد الفطر، وزيارة ستراتفورد

lines: ARTS 5   Telford Hall Episode 2 — Part 1 (PB p. 55)
[Complete story pages available offline in assets/ref/pb_p055.webp & pb_p056.webp; full scene anchors below for WB Arts 5 A–G:]

Christmas Break & Liverpool Visit: As winter approached and days got shorter, Ahmed realized he would soon be by himself for three weeks. He suddenly missed home: warm evenings walking on the beach, camping in the desert, his friends, and his mother's evening cooking. While looking at the ceiling, Bob knocked and passed on his parents' invitation to spend Christmas with them near Liverpool. Later in the Telford Hall lounge, Ahmed wrote 'Dear Khaled' telling his brother about Liverpool, the surrounding countryside, and Christmas Day when Bob's older sister Jenny came with her husband Graham and two children (it felt strange hearing children call Bob 'Uncle').

Ramadan & Eid al-Fitr Party: One morning Ahmed invited Bob to eat in his room, explaining Ramadan (fasting dawn to dusk as a duty) and Eid al-Fitr ('asked Bob.Another explanation followed.'). He had also invited Mick, Jerry and Derek and a couple of others. Ahmed pushed all the furniture to one end of his room around a brass tray from his parents, piled high with meat and rice, plus two dishes of sweet pastry with honey and nuts — made after giving his recipes and spices to the Telford Hall cooks and helping them all afternoon. Earlier in the day he phoned his family to wish them a good Eid, played cassettes from home, passed around sweet pastry, and felt good celebrating Eid al-Fitr with his new friends.
content.caption: Christmas lights in Norton (PB page 55)

lines: ARTS 5   Telford Hall Episode 2 — Part 2: Stratford-upon-Avon (PB pp. 55–56)

Weekend Before Exams: Before sitting six three-hour end-of-year exam papers (morning and afternoon over three days), Ahmed took a weekend off with Bob to visit Stratford-upon-Avon (about three hours' drive from Norton).

Shakespeare's Birthplace & River Avon: On Saturday morning they visited the actual 16th-century house where William Shakespeare was born on April 23rd, 1564, seeing heavy wooden furniture, 16th-century kitchen cooking equipment, the birth room and Shakespeare's school desk. They stayed at the local Youth Hostel and spent Sunday morning rowing on the River Avon (which gives the town its name).

Royal Shakespeare Theatre & Souvenirs: Ahmed pointed to the huge brick Royal Shakespeare Theatre ('They do three of four different ones every year', out of Shakespeare's 37 plays). In tourist shops selling Shakespeare teapots, dolls and toothbrushes, Ahmed bought a photo book of the town, copies of Shakespeare's plays, and a special mirror painted with Shakespeare's beard, eyebrows and hair ('I'll give it Khaled,' said Ahmed. 'I think he will like it.').
Discussion: Explain Eid Al-Fitr in English.

interactive_spot.label: ملخص القراءة وشرح Eid al-Fitr بالإنجليزية (PB ص 56)

simple_explain.html:
• جواب سؤال المناقشة (Explain Eid Al-Fitr in English): Eid al-Fitr is an Islamic celebration marking the end of Ramadan, the month in which Muslims fast from dawn to dusk. On Eid morning Muslims pray, phone and visit family, wear nice clothes, and share special meat, rice dishes and sweet pastries with relatives and friends.
  • دليل التمييز الثقافي: عرّف أحمد زملاءه البريطانيين بصيام رمضان ومذاق الكرم والضيافة اليمنية داخل سكن طلابي إنجليزي.

example.html: Inference clue (WB E #4): Why wasn't there a microwave oven in Shakespeare's kitchen? Because all furniture and cooking equipment in the kitchen was from that period (16th century — 1564).

activities.prompt_literal: ARTS 5 B Read the first part of the story (to ... with his new friends) and number the events in the correct order.
activities.prompt_ar: رقّم أحداث الجزء الأول العشرة من 1 إلى 10 حسب الترتيب الزمني لوقوعها في PB ص 55 (WB ص 87):

items.prompt: ______ Ahmed invited Bob to spend Eid with him.
______ Ahmed invited Mick, Jerry and Derek to spend Eid with him.
______ Ahmed made a space in his room for everybody to sit down.
______ Ahmed met Bob's brother [sister Jenny] and his wife [husband Graham].
______ Ahmed phoned his family to wish them a good Eid.
______ Ahmed went to Liverpool with Bob.
______ Bob invited Ahmed to his parents' house.

hints: 1 دعوة بوب ← 2 إغلاق الكلية ← 3 السفر إلى ليفربول ← 4 لقاء عائلة أخت بوب (طُبعت في التمرين brother بدل sister) ← 5 الرسالة لخالد ← 6 دعوة بوب للعيد ← 7 دعوة ميك وجيري وديريك ← 8 اتصال العيد بأهله صباحاً ← 9 تجهيز الغرفة ← 10 قضاء العيد معاً.

activities.prompt_literal: C–D Read the second part of the story on PB pages 55 and 56 and check your answers to these questions (1–4):
activities.prompt_ar: أجب عن الأسئلة الأربعة حول زيارة ستراتفورد بعد القراءة (WB ص 88):

items.question: 1 Why did Ahmed want to visit Stratford-upon-Avon?
items.model_answer: To relax before his end-of-year exams and see the birthplace of William Shakespeare.

items.question: 2 When was William Shakespeare born?
items.model_answer: On April 23rd, 1564.

items.question: 3 Why is the town called Stratford-upon-Avon?
items.model_answer: Because it stands on / beside the River Avon (which gives the town part of its name).

items.question: 4 What is there to see, do and buy in Stratford-upon-Avon?
items.model_answer: See: old 16th-century houses and Shakespeare's birthplace (furniture, kitchen tools, birth room, school desk). Do: walk around town, row on the River Avon, watch Shakespeare's plays at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre. Buy: Shakespeare teapots, dolls, toothbrushes, photo books, copies of his plays, and special painted mirrors.

hints: قسّم الجواب الرابع إلى ثلاثة أقسام: ما يُرى (See)، وما يُفعل (Do)، وما يُشترى (Buy).

activities.prompt_literal: E These statements are true. Explain how you know from the information in the story.
activities.prompt_ar: استدل من القصة على صدق العبارات الست (WB ص 88):

items.question: 1 Christmas is in winter in England.
items.model_answer: When students began talking about going home for Christmas, the story states 'Winter was approaching and the days were getting shorter.'

items.question: 2 Norton College is closed for three weeks at Christmas.
items.model_answer: When Ahmed heard the students would go home for Christmas, he realized he would soon be by himself for three weeks.

items.question: 3 Mick and Jerry are friends of Ahmed.
items.model_answer: Ahmed invited Mick, Jerry and Derek to Eid in his room and the story concludes he felt good celebrating 'with his new friends'.

items.question: 4 There wasn't a microwave oven in the kitchen of the house Ahmed visited
items.model_answer: Because all furniture and even the cooking equipment in the kitchen was from the 16th century (long before microwaves were invented).
items.explain_ar: استنتاج منطقي من تاريخ المنزل وأدواته.

items.question: 5 Shakespeare never performed in the Royal Shakespeare Theatre.
items.model_answer: Shakespeare lived in the 16th century (born 1564), whereas the huge brick Royal Shakespeare Theatre is a later theatre where modern actors ('they') perform his plays today.
items.explain_ar: فرق الزمن وتعبير They perform Shakespeare's plays there.

items.question: 6 Khaled has a sense of humour.
items.model_answer: Ahmed bought a funny mirror with Shakespeare's beard, eyebrows and hair painted on it (so anyone looking in it looks like Shakespeare) and said he thought Khaled would like it.
items.explain_ar: ذوق خالد في تقبّل الهدايا الطريفة يدل على خفة ظله.

hints: البحث عن الجمل المستنتجة (implicit clues) هو هدف هذا التمرين.

items.question: 5 give to the cooks?
items.model_answer: His recipes and spices.
items.explain_ar: وأمضى بعد الظهر يساعدهم في المطبخ.

items.question: 6 play at his party?
items.model_answer: Some cassettes from home.

items.question: 7 pass around at his party?
items.model_answer: Two dishes of sweet pastry (made with honey and nuts).

items.question: 8 stay at in Stratford?
items.model_answer: The local Youth Hostel.

items.question: 9 spend the next morning doing in Stratford?
items.model_answer: Rowing on the River Avon.

items.question: 10 buy in Stratford?
items.model_answer: A book of photographs of the town, some copies of Shakespeare's plays, and a special mirror painted with Shakespeare's beard, eyebrows and hair.

questions.stem: In PB page 56, how did Ahmed know that the kitchen in Shakespeare's house could not have had modern appliances (WB Arts 5 E #4)?

options.text: Even the cooking equipment in the kitchen was from the 16th century.
Bob had stayed at a Youth Hostel without a kitchen.
options.why_wrong: بيت الشباب يخص مبيتهم ولا يدل على مطبخ منزل شكسبير التاريخي.

options.text: Ahmed gave his spices to the Telford Hall cooks.
options.why_wrong: مطبخ تيلفورد هول يخص حفلة العيد لا متحف ستراتفورد.
لم يذكر النص فيضاناً بل قاموا بالتجديف في النهر صباحاً.

hints: انظر وصف أثاث وأدوات المنزل التاريخي في الفقرة الثانية من ص 56.
questions.explain: ذكر النص صراحة أن الأثاث بل وأدوات الطبخ في المطبخ تعود جميعها إلى القرن السادس عشر.

questions.stem: What did Ahmed buy in Stratford as a humorous gift for his brother Khaled (WB Arts 5 E #6 & F #10)?

options.text: A special mirror painted with Shakespeare's beard, eyebrows and hair.
A brass tray piled with meat and rice.
options.why_wrong: صينية النحاس أرسلها والداه لأحمد عند إقامته في السكن.
الاستبانات أعطاها المحاضر في الحلقة الأولى.
تلك تذكارات كانت معروضة في المتاجر، بينما اشترى أحمد كتاب صور ونسخ مسرحيات والمرآة الخاصة لخالد.

hints: هدية طريفة تجعل الناظر فيها يبدو مثل شكسبير.
questions.explain: اشترى أحمد المرآة المرسوم عليها لحية شكسبير وحاجباه وشعره وقال إنه سيهديها لخالد لأنها ستعجبه.
